title: A title or picture right-click leads with Animate and Add Key, as the animate mock draws it
goal: Decide whether a title or picture on the timeline should offer Animate and Add Key at the top of its right-click menu, as the animation mock draws them, instead of one level down under More where the short-menu rework put them.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-animate.html, the key line contextmenu (onKeyLine): Animate, Add Key, Remove Key / Split at Playhead, Speed, Delete. The 2026-10-17 short-menu rework (task a-clip-s-right-click-menu-is-short-and-only-says, docs/design/timeline-right-click.md, TimelineMenuTable) put Animate and Add Key under More on every clip kind to hold the top level to about ten rows, per the user's ask that day.
acceptance: The user has chosen on the decision card
If they chose the top level: a title and a picture lead with Animate and Add Key at the playhead time, the menu stays within the table budget, and the timeline right-click menus walk checks it

log.note: Waiting on the decision card: Animate and Add Key on top of a title's right-click, or under More
